name: Daemonic Patrons
community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21. Crit-Wound grant applies to all attacks (no weapon-type restriction); the end-of-phase self-destruction cannot encode the by-this-unit kill attribution, so it gates on any enemy destroyed that phase.

name: Internal Rivalries
community_notes: [APPROX] Models: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTERs ignore characteristic modifiers (the rule covers only the Move characteristic; encoded as all characteristics — strongest case), ignore modifiers to their Advance and Charge rolls, plus the Favoured Champions re-roll (re-roll the Wound roll). Not modeled: the dynamic Favoured Champions designation — initially the Warlord's unit, reassigned to the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER that first destroys an enemy unit each player-turn — so the Wound re-roll is expressed as a blanket CHARACTER buff rather than restricted to the single Favoured Champions unit. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Daemonic Empowerment
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the Empowered buff — while within 6" of a friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit, weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] — from the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN side. The symmetric case (a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit empowered by a nearby EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit) and the upgrade clause (a weapon that already has [SUSTAINED HITS] instead scores a Critical Hit on an unmodified 5+) are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Master of the Pageant
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the 1CP reduction as a refund on a Stratagem use. The rule restricts this to the Sinuous Breach and Prideful Superiority Stratagems targeting a FULGRIM unit, and to once per battle round — restrictions not gated here. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

name: Beautiful Death
community_notes: Add 1 to the roll while this unit is your army's Favoured Champions; the Favoured Champions bonus is not encoded.

name: Devoted Duellists
community_notes: Targets one or more Character units that have not fought this phase; the ability applies only while attacking one selected enemy unit.

name: Diabolic Majesty
community_notes: Used just after a Character unit becomes your army's Favoured Champions; each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

name: Heightened Jealousy
community_notes: Applies to Emperor's Children Character units that are NOT your army's Favoured Champions; the Favoured Champions exclusion is not encoded.

name: Refusal to Be Outdone
community_notes: Used when charging within 12" of an engaged enemy unit; the unit must end the charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

name: Vengeful Surge
community_notes: If the unit is not your army's Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the surge-distance dice; the re-roll rider is not encoded.

name: Dark Apparitions
community_notes: The 6" (instead of 9") Deep Strike return applies only in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase and requires setting up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly Emperor's Children units.

name: Ecstatic Slaughter
community_notes: Used after a Legions of Excess unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase; a friendly unengaged Emperor's Children unit within 6" of it can declare a charge. If it already fought this phase, it cannot fight again.

name: Sustained by Agony
community_notes: After this unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6" either has one model recover up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a Daemonettes unit, returns up to D3+3 destroyed models instead.

name: Sycophantic Surge
community_notes: At least one target of the charge must be within Engagement Range of one or more Emperor's Children units from your army.

name: Violent Crescendo
community_notes: Pile-in and Consolidation moves need not end closer to the closest enemy model, provided they end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

name: Cruel Bladesman
community_notes: The unit must have made a Charge move this turn.

name: Cut Down the Weak
community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit Falls Back within 6"; the charge must target that enemy unit and the unit receives no Charge bonus this turn. Vehicles can only be selected if they are Walkers.

name: Incessant Violence
community_notes: The unit must end the Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

name: Terrifying Spectacle
community_notes: Used in the opponent's Command phase on a unit that Charged and destroyed an enemy unit last turn; each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if Below Half-strength, and affected units skip their other Battle-shock tests this phase.

name: Advance and Claim
community_notes: The Transport must have one or more non-Battle-shocked Tormentors units embarked; the objective it is in range of becomes sticky.

name: Ceaseless Onslaught
community_notes: The unit disembarked from a Transport that made a Normal move this turn and is eligible to declare a charge this phase.

name: Dynamic Breakthrough
community_notes: Models can move through enemy models (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) without ending in Engagement Range; Desperate Escape tests are automatically passed.

name: On to the Next
community_notes: At the end of the Fight phase, a unit that destroyed an enemy unit this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport it can embark within may embark, even in a turn it disembarked.

name: Outflanking Strike
community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, one Transport (or up to two Dedicated Transports) wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge is placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Reactive Disembarkation
community_notes: Used when the Transport is targeted; one embarked Emperor's Children unit disembarks anywhere wholly within 6" of the Transport and outside Engagement Range.

name: Cruel Raiders
community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, a unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" horizontally from all enemy units is placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Dark Vigour
community_notes: Triggered just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8"; the unit makes a Normal move of up to 6".

name: Honour the Prince
community_notes: If the unit Advances, no Advance roll is made; instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of its models until the end of the phase.

name: Catalytic Stimulus
community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit has shot, on a unit that lost one or more wounds to those attacks.

name: Close-Quarters Excruciation
community_notes: Applies only to attacks made by Emperor's Children models against eligible targets within 12"; the range gate is not encoded.

name: Armour of Abhorrence
community_notes: Worsens the Armour Penetration of incoming attacks by 1 until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

name: Embrace the Pain
community_notes: [APPROX] Each enemy model within Engagement Range of this unit must select it as the target of its attacks; encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Unbound Arrogance
community_notes: Used just after the unit destroys an enemy unit; increases your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.

name: Unshakeable Opponents
community_notes: Also ignores modifiers to the attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic.

name: Duellist's Death
community_notes: Add 1 to the roll if the unit has Flawless Blades; the bonus is not encoded.

name: Profane Desecration
community_notes: At the end of your Movement phase, one objective the unit controls becomes secured.

name: Eager to Prove
community_notes: While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, also add 2" to the Move characteristic of its models; the Favoured Champions rider is not encoded.

name: Repulsed by Weakness
community_notes: [APPROX] Enemy units (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) Falling Back from within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit take Desperate Escape tests, at -1 while the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Proud and Vainglorious
community_notes: While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, also add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of its models; the rider is not encoded.

name: Empyric Suffusion
community_notes: The Heroic Intervention stratagem costs 1 CP less when targeting the bearer's unit.

name: Possessed Blade
community_notes: [APPROX] One selected melee weapon gains +1 Attacks. Additionally, each time the bearer is selected to fight it can empower that weapon: +1 Damage plus [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [HAZARDOUS] for those attacks. The optional empowerment is encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Warp Walker
community_notes: Emperor's Children or Keeper of Secrets model only. Models in the unit can move through enemy models on Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves (not ending in Engagement Range) and automatically pass Desperate Escape tests.

name: Faultless Opportunist
community_notes: The Heroic Intervention stratagem can target the bearer's unit regardless of other uses this phase, costs 1 CP less when doing so, and does not prevent uses on other units.

name: Rise to the Challenge
community_notes: At the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can fight one additional time, applying one Exquisite Swordsmanship ability to those attacks.

name: Sublime Prescience
community_notes: In your Movement phase, one friendly Emperor's Children Transport in Strategic Reserves treats the battle round as one higher for arrival purposes.

name: Accomplished Tactician
community_notes: [APPROX] In the opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, one friendly Emperor's Children unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit can embark within a friendly Transport it is wholly within 6" of. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Heretek Adept
community_notes: When a saving throw is failed for a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle model within 6" of the bearer, change that attack's Damage characteristic to 0.

name: Tactical Perfection
community_notes: After deployment, redeploy up to two Emperor's Children units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of the usual limits.

name: Loathsome Dexterity
community_notes: Models in the bearer's unit can move through enemy models on Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves (not ending in Engagement Range); Desperate Escape tests are automatically passed.

name: Tears of the Phoenix
community_notes: Also ignores modifiers to the attack's Weapon Skill characteristic.

name: Soulstain Made Manifest
community_notes: At the start of the Fight phase, one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

name: Pledge of Dark Glory
community_notes: Improves Leadership by 1 (lower is better, encoded as -1) and Objective Control by 1 while the bearer is leading a unit.

name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of your Shooting phase, one visible enemy unit within 12" takes a Leadership test (-2 if Battle-shocked); if failed, it suffers 3 mortal wounds. The test-then-damage is encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
community_notes: Once per turn, just after making a Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, treat the result as an unmodified 6.

name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
community_notes: The return is gated on passing a Leadership test taken for the bearer at the end of the phase; the test gate is not encoded. Wounds regained are capped at the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

name: Invigorating Agonies
community_notes: In the opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot and hit this unit, the unit can make a surge move of up to D3+1".

name: Martial Perfection
community_notes: Unit Upgrade (Infractors unit only, not a Character Enhancement): once per battle, in the Fight phase when an enemy unit targets this unit, attacks that target it get -1 to Hit rolls.
